title: Listening Drill — Missing kit
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Missing kit
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a drama kit. The main problem is missing fabric. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the packing list. Then bring the item to the costume office. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a spare set. bring the rest of the kit in its bag. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
